_comment: Few-shot KD baseline for steer_text: teacher A = google-t5/t5-base fine-tuned on SNLI (Hub checkpoint, same as text_rebase_t5base_t5large_steer_hubcheckpoint.json), student B trained on the same few_shot support set, logit KL on the 3 NLI classes. The student's head starts from the nearest-mean head (target_task_heads), which also defines the baseline column; build it with scripts/build_nearest_mean_head.py on the student base, with the same --few-shot/--seed as kd.
_target_note: Same B as the steer configs (t5-v1_1-large).
